fatal_errors: The proposed grain-size/phase-uniformity mechanism does not reconstruct the target temperature-driven transition in lattice disorder and dislocation density.
It omits the central controlled intervention: indentation and friction simulations at 300, 600, 900, and 1200 K.
The claimed grain-size ranges, improvement percentages, and 15% falsification threshold have no cited or supplied evidentiary basis.
Grain size and phase distribution are changed together, so the proposed experiment cannot identify which mediator governs wear.
explanation: The hypothesis is broadly relevant to HEA coating wear, but it addresses a different and only generic microstructural mechanism. It misses the FeNiCrCoCu/Cu model, simulation conditions, 300 K baseline, approximately 900 K boundary, HCP/dislocation measurements, modulus increase at 600 K, and sharp hardness and wear-resistance losses with increased friction above 900 K. Although it supplies a baseline, range, directional prediction, and falsification rule, these are arbitrary and unsupported. The experiment also confounds grain size with phase uniformity and does not distinguish the target lattice-disorder mechanism.
